description: Unit test code for the TextFileReader class in the webkitpy.style.filereader module, testing file processing, error handling, and internal state.

classes.name: TextFileReaderTest
classes.description: Test suite for the TextFileReader class, including setup, teardown, and multiple test cases for file processing.

classes.name: MockProcessor
classes.description: Mock implementation of ProcessorBase used to record process() calls during tests.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment, including creating a temporary directory and setting up the TextFileReader with a mock processor.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Cleans up test environment by removing temporary directories.

methods.name: _create_file
methods.description: Creates a file with specified relative path and text content, returning the full file path.

methods.name: _passed_to_processor
methods.description: Returns the list of parameters passed to the mock processor during processing.

methods.name: _assert_file_reader
methods.description: Asserts that the processed data and file count match expected values.

methods.name: test_process_file__does_not_exist
methods.description: Tests behavior when processing a non-existent file, expecting a SystemExit and log message.

methods.name: test_process_file__is_dir
methods.description: Tests behavior when processing a directory path, expecting a warning log.

methods.name: test_process_file__should_not_process
methods.description: Tests that files ending with 'should_not_process.txt' are skipped.

methods.name: test_process_file__multiple_lines
methods.description: Tests processing of a file with multiple lines and different line endings.

methods.name: test_process_file__file_stdin
methods.description: Tests processing of a file with path '-' simulating stdin, with an additional test keyword.

methods.name: test_process_file__with_kwarg
methods.description: Tests processing of a file with an extra keyword argument.

methods.name: test_process_paths
methods.description: Tests processing of a list containing both files and directories.
